$comment: PRIVACY: This message must never contain raw identifying user data. The message field must be safe for display; it must not echo credentials or tokens.
title: Auth Failure

code.description: rate_limited (protocol 37): the cloud refused the sign-up or login, or the device registration or reissue that completes it, for too many attempts (429). The message says how long to wait, which Rust works out from the response's Retry-After; Swift shows it as it is.
